ctaTitle: Can’t see what you need? Search

sections.html: People often search for the wrong specialist first. A short guide: an accountant deals with tax, accounts and advice; a bookkeeper keeps your day-to-day records; an employment lawyer advises on contracts and disputes; and an HR consultant helps with policies and people processes. If you are unsure, start with the page closest to your problem and use its questions to decide.

Whatever the service, compare scope and what is included, not just price, check qualifications with the relevant professional body, and ask for terms in writing. Our walkthrough on choosing an accountant shows the approach, and it works for most professional services.

faqs.q: Are the professionals on ProFinders vetted?
faqs.a: No. ProFinders is an introduction service and does not employ, vet or guarantee professionals, so check qualifications and terms yourself before you hire.

faqs.q: Is the information on these pages legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. The pages give general guidance only. For advice on your own situation, speak to a qualified professional.
